verdict.rationale: Stable has a public pricing page that mentions plan-wide terms (change-of-address guidance, a 30-day money-back guarantee, AI summaries). The product pages say scans are free and forwarding includes discounted rates, but no actual dollar figures appear anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: monthly plan prices, scan allowances per plan, per-item fees for extra scans, forwarding, storage and check deposit, and independent confirmation that pricing is complete.
